fields.v: Conceptual — self-described survey with no described search (no sources or query; selection only by a four-criterion 'operational boundary' (update target, update source, update reuse, capability improvement) over a 'curated collection' and companion catalogue): taxonomy of self-evolving coding agents by update target (assets / architecture / model) over 108 methods, plus analysis of coding signals, adoption timing, benchmarks and products. Assessed with Q1-Q13 as conceptual, not DARE (rule of 2026-11-23: sources not described)
fields.quote: The operational boundary. We identify self-evolving coding agents using four criteria that examine how code-related experience changes the agent itself and whether reusing those changes improves subsequent coding performance:
fields.why: The value says no inclusion/exclusion criteria are described, but p. 8 states four inclusion criteria; the conceptual classification still holds because no sources or search are described.
fields.doubt: O valor diz que não há critérios de inclusão, mas a pág. 8 dá quatro critérios ('operational boundary'). Continua conceptual porque não há fontes nem pesquisa. Corrige a frase aqui e a mesma frase nas Notes.
